006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.object.AmbiguousDate;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.object.AmbiguousDateTime;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.DateTimeFunctionException;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.DateWithoutTimeZoneItemImpl;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
017
018import java.time.LocalDate;
019import java.time.ZoneOffset;
020import java.time.ZonedDateTime;
021import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
022
023import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
024import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
025
026/**
027 * An atomic Metapath item representing a date value in the Metapath system with
028 * or without an explicit time zone.
029 * <p>
030 * This interface provides functionality for handling date/time values with or
031 * without time zone information, supporting parsing, casting, and comparison
032 * operations. It works in conjunction with {@link ZonedDateTime} to handle time
033 * zone ambiguity.
034 */
035public interface IDateItem extends ICalendarTemporalItem {
036  /**
037   * Get the type information for this item.
038   *
039   * @return the type information
040   */
041  @NonNull
042  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IDateItem> type() {
043    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.DATE.getItemType();
044  }
045
046  @Override
047  default IAtomicOrUnionType<? extends IDateItem> getType() {
048    return type();
049  }
050
051  /**
052   * Construct a new date item using the provided string {@code value}.
053   *
054   * @param value
055   *          a string representing a date
056   * @return the new item
057   */
058  @NonNull
059  static IDateItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
060    try {
061      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.DATE.parse(value));
062    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
063      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
064          null,
065          String.format("Invalid date value '%s'. %s",
066              value,
067              ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
068          ex);
069    }
070  }
071
072  /**
073   * Construct a new date item using the provided {@code value}.
074   * <p>
075   * This method handles recording if an explicit timezone was provided using the
076   * {@code hasTimeZone} parameter. The {@link AmbiguousDate#hasTimeZone()} method
077   * can be called to determine if timezone information is present.
078   *
079   * @param value
080   *          a date, without time zone information
081   * @param hasTimeZone
082   *          {@code true} if the date/time is intended to have an associated time
083   *          zone or {@code false} otherwise
084   * @return the new item
085   * @see AmbiguousDateTime for more details on timezone handling
086   */
087  @NonNull
088  static IDateItem valueOf(@NonNull ZonedDateTime value, boolean hasTimeZone) {
089    ZonedDateTime truncated = ObjectUtils.notNull(value.truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.DAYS));
090    return hasTimeZone
091        ? IDateWithTimeZoneItem.valueOf(truncated)
092        : valueOf(new AmbiguousDate(truncated, false));
093  }
094
095  /**
096   * Construct a new date item using the provided {@code value}.
097   * <p>
098   * This method handles recording that the timezone is implicit.
099   *
100   * @param value
101   *          a date, without time zone information
102   * @return the new item
103   * @see AmbiguousDateTime for more details on timezone handling
104   */
105  @NonNull
106  static IDateItem valueOf(@NonNull LocalDate value) {
107    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(value.atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC)), false);
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Construct a new date item using the provided {@code value}.
112   *
113   * @param value
114   *          an ambiguous date with time zone information already identified
115   * @return the new item
116   */
117  @NonNull
118  static IDateItem valueOf(@NonNull AmbiguousDate value) {
119    return value.hasTimeZone()
120        ? IDateWithTimeZoneItem.valueOf(value.getValue())
121        : new DateWithoutTimeZoneItemImpl(value);
122  }
123
124  @Override
125  default boolean hasDate() {
126    return true;
127  }
128
129  @Override
130  default boolean hasTime() {
131    return false;
132  }
133
134  @Override
135  default int getYear() {
136    return asZonedDateTime().getYear();
137  }
138
139  @Override
140  default int getMonth() {
141    return asZonedDateTime().getMonthValue();
142  }
143
144  @Override
145  default int getDay() {
146    return asZonedDateTime().getDayOfMonth();
147  }
148
149  @Override
150  default int getHour() {
151    return 0;
152  }
153
154  @Override
155  default int getMinute() {
156    return 0;
157  }
158
159  @Override
160  default int getSecond() {
161    return 0;
162  }
163
164  @Override
165  default int getNano() {
166    return 0;
167  }
168
169  /**
170   * Get this date as a date/time value at the start of the day.
171   *
172   * @return the date time value
173   */
174  @NonNull
175  default IDateTimeItem asDateTime() {
176    return IDateTimeItem.valueOf(this);
177  }
178
179  @Override
180  @NonNull
181  ZonedDateTime asZonedDateTime();
182
183  /**
184   * Get the date as a {@link LocalDate}.
185   *
186   * @return the date
187   */
188  @NonNull
189  default LocalDate asLocalDate() {
190    return ObjectUtils.notNull(asZonedDateTime().toLocalDate());
191  }
192
193  /**
194   * Adjusts an xs:dateTime value to a specific timezone, or to no timezone at
195   * all.
196   * <p>
197   * This method does one of the following things based on the arguments.
198   * <ol>
199   * <li>If the provided offset is {@code null} and the provided date/time value
200   * has a timezone, the timezone is maked absent.
201   * <li>If the provided offset is {@code null} and the provided date/time value
202   * has an absent timezone, the date/time value is returned.
203   * <li>If the provided offset is not {@code null} and the provided date/time
204   * value has an absent timezone, the date/time value is returned with the new
205   * timezone applied.
206   * <li>Otherwise, the provided timezone is applied to the date/time value
207   * adjusting the time instant.
208   * </ol>
209   * <p>
210   * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
211   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-adjust-dateTime-to-timezone">fn:adjust-dateTime-to-timezone</a>
212   * function.
213   *
214   * @param offset
215   *          the timezone offset to use or {@code null}
216   * @return the adjusted date/time value
217   * @throws DateTimeFunctionException
218   *           with code
219   *           {@link DateTimeFunctionException#INVALID_TIME_ZONE_VALUE_ERROR} if
220   *           the offset is &lt; -PT14H or &gt; PT14H
221   */
222  @Override
223  default IDateItem replaceTimezone(@Nullable IDayTimeDurationItem offset) {
224    return offset == null
225        ? hasTimezone()
226            ? valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asZonedDateTime().withZoneSameLocal(ZoneOffset.UTC)), false)
227            : this
228        : hasTimezone()
229            ? valueOf(IDateTimeItem.valueOf(this).replaceTimezone(offset).asZonedDateTime(),
230                true)
231            : valueOf(
232                ObjectUtils.notNull(asZonedDateTime().withZoneSameLocal(offset.asZoneOffset())),
233                true);
234  }
235
236  /**
237   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
238   *
239   * @param item
240   *          the item to cast
241   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
242   *         cast to this type
243   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
244   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
245   */
246  @NonNull
247  static IDateItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
248    IDateItem retval;
249    if (item instanceof IDateItem) {
250      retval = (IDateItem) item;
251    } else if (item instanceof IDateTimeItem) {
252      retval = ((IDateTimeItem) item).asDate();
253    } else if (item instanceof IStringItem || item instanceof IUntypedAtomicItem) {
254      try {
255        retval = valueOf(item.asString());
256      } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
257        // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
258        throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
259      }
260    } else {
261      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(
262          String.format("Unsupported item type '%s'", item.getClass().getName()));
263    }
264    return retval;
265  }
266
267  @Override
268  default IDateItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
269    return cast(item);
270  }
271}
